outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of the experimental pipeline, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B shows representative microscopy/imaging photographs, not a quantitative plot of averages.
The bar graph showing mean lactate concentration with 95% CI also displays individual data points (dots) for each region overlaid on the bars for Normal, LUAD, and LUSC groups.
The bar graph showing mean lactate concentration with 95% CI for high pH and low pH regions also displays individual data points (dots) overlaid on the bars.
Panel E is a schematic illustration of the immunosuppressive tumor niche, not a data plot.
